title: Measuring Alignment Robustness to Adversarial Prompt Injection After Fine-Tuning
original_idea: Administer a standard prompt injection test suite to a model before and after fine-tuning on an unrelated task. Measure the change in injection success rate. Correlate injection susceptibility increase with alignment score degradation.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: fine-tuning -> increased prompt injection susceptibility -> security-alignment compound risk affecting all fine-tuned deployments. Each link is explicit and the safety implication is broad and practical.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Standard prompt injection test suites exist (e.g., BIPIA, TensorTrust). Fine-tuning with HuggingFace/LoRA is well-documented. Before/after comparison methodology is straightforward. Intermediate, suitable for beginners with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused first deliverable: one model, one FT task, one injection test suite, before/after comparison. The injection success rate change is a clean, self-contained result achievable within 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
